axiom_audit.scope: Exact Check-module build log; every manifest declaration exactly once

serial_policy.mechanism: Synchronous commands; successful no-build deps guard immediately before each single-module build; unchanged inputs; coordinator-exclusive lock.
serial_policy.os_global_process_audit: Not performed; external exclusivity is a coordinator precondition, not a polling claim.

proof_migration: Root separately reviews migration; this script binds delivered bytes and manifest only.

trusted_cache.scope: Existing fixed dependency source/build artifacts, including Mathlib and toolchain; no root-project olean copied or symlinked.

package_acceptance: Complete manifest module set, one fresh serial Lake build and checker pass; source work-module acceptance performed separately by coordinator.
